title: Reservations Schedule: Early-Booking Reduction on the Respite Medication Setup Charge
content:
| Days from booking to planned arrival | Early-booking reduction on medication setup |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | 10 percent |
| 14 to 20 | 5 percent |
| 13 or fewer | Nothing |

**Schedule note.** For the medication setup charge of a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, the early-booking reduction is ten percent when the stay was booked twenty-one or more days before its planned arrival date, five percent when it was booked fourteen to twenty days before, and nothing otherwise.

**Counting.** The days are the planned arrival date less the booking date, in calendar days, both as recorded on the stay.

**What it reduces.** The reduction is taken on the packaging charge of the medication setup as it stands, and on nothing else in the charge: the packaging charge is multiplied by 90 percent at 10 percent and by 95 percent at 5 percent.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, planned arrival 30 June)

| Booked on | Days before arrival | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 9 June | 21 | 10 percent |
| 10 June | 20 | 5 percent |
| 16 June | 14 | 5 percent |
| 17 June | 13 | Nothing |
